roadmaps.title: Observational Astronomy
roadmaps.tagline: Learn the night sky with your eyes, binoculars, and eventually a telescope.
roadmaps.curricula: University Astronomy 101 syllabi and the Astronomical League's observing programs
roadmaps.endpoint: from nothing to reading the northern night sky unaided
roadmaps.about: Observational astronomy is the practice of reading the night sky with your own eyes — finding your bearings among the constellations, following the Moon and planets through their cycles, and learning to see faint things well. This category walks from a first night under the sky through naked-eye navigation, binocular astronomy, and deep-sky observing, to choosing and using a telescope. No equipment is needed for most of the path: the sky is free, and the skill is in the looking.

roadmaps.title: Home Horticulture
roadmaps.tagline: Grow food and flowers that actually thrive, from soil test to seed saving
roadmaps.endpoint: from a soil test to food and flowers that thrive
roadmaps.about: Horticulture is the craft of growing plants well — vegetables, herbs, and flowers raised from soil, seed, and season rather than luck. This category starts where every good garden starts, with the soil itself, then walks through planning, propagation, planting, watering, feeding, and the steady work of keeping plants healthy through the year, ending with harvests and saving seed for the next one.

roadmaps.title: Kitchen Confidence
roadmaps.tagline: From mise en place to cooking without recipes, built on salt, fat, acid, and heat
roadmaps.curricula: Culinary-school fundamentals and Samin Nosrat's Salt Fat Acid Heat framework
roadmaps.endpoint: from mise en place to cooking a full meal without a recipe
roadmaps.about: Cooking is the everyday skill of turning ingredients into meals you actually want to eat. This category builds from knife work and mise en place through the four elements that make food taste right — salt, fat, acid, and heat — and the core methods built on them: sautéing, roasting, braising, and more. The endpoint is confidence, not recipes: understanding what's happening in the pan well enough to cook without instructions.

roadmaps.title: Functional Fitness
roadmaps.tagline: Build a body that works — strength, endurance, and mobility for real life.
roadmaps.curricula: NASM & ACE training fundamentals, physical-literacy curricula
roadmaps.disclaimer: General conditioning education, not a prescription. Stop on pain, and clear new programs with a clinician if you have a health condition or are new to exercise.
roadmaps.endpoint: from sedentary to a sustainable strength-and-mobility routine
roadmaps.about: Physical fitness is the general capacity your body brings to everything else — strength to lift, endurance to keep going, and mobility to move freely without pain. This category covers the fundamentals of training all three safely: how muscles adapt, how to structure a week, and how to progress without injury, built for real life rather than the mirror.

roadmaps.title: Everyday First Aid & Readiness
roadmaps.tagline: Know what to do in the minutes before help arrives — and get certified for real.
roadmaps.curricula: Red Cross & AHA first-aid curricula, FEMA preparedness guidance
roadmaps.disclaimer: Awareness-level education only — not certification, not medical advice. In an emergency, call your local emergency number first. For real credentials, take a certified Red Cross or AHA course.
roadmaps.endpoint: from bystander to the person who knows the next three minutes
roadmaps.about: First aid is what a bystander does in the minutes before professional help arrives — recognizing an emergency, calling for help well, and keeping a person safe until someone with training takes over. This category builds awareness of the most common emergencies, from bleeding and burns to choking and cardiac arrest, and points to the certified courses where the hands-on skills are properly learned.

roadmaps.title: Mental Health Foundations
roadmaps.tagline: Evidence-based self-care skills — and knowing when to get real help
roadmaps.curricula: CBT protocols (Beck), Kabat-Zinn's MBSR, WHO mental-health guidance
roadmaps.disclaimer: Educational self-care skills, not diagnosis or treatment. If you're struggling, talk to a professional — in the US, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
roadmaps.endpoint: from coping on autopilot to skills that work — and knowing when to get help
roadmaps.about: Mental health is cared for like physical health: with knowledge, daily practices, and the judgment to know when professional support is the right move. This category teaches evidence-based self-care skills — understanding stress and emotion, sleep, thought patterns, and connection — always alongside the pathways to real help when self-care is not enough.

roadmaps.title: Mindfulness & Meditation
roadmaps.tagline: Train attention and equanimity with a practice that actually survives contact with real life
roadmaps.endpoint: from restless first sits to a practice that survives real life
roadmaps.about: Meditation is the deliberate training of attention and equanimity — sitting down, noticing where the mind goes, and returning, thousands of times. This category walks from the first honest sit through breath practice, working with the wandering mind, body awareness, and open awareness, to building a practice that survives contact with ordinary busy life.

roadmaps.title: Applied Compassion
roadmaps.tagline: Train the skill of caring well — for others and yourself
roadmaps.curricula: Stanford CCT, Rosenberg's Nonviolent Communication, Neff's self-compassion research
roadmaps.endpoint: from good intentions to a daily caring practice that holds under stress
roadmaps.about: Compassion is a trainable skill, not a temperament — the practiced ability to notice suffering, in others and yourself, and respond well. This category treats caring as something you do: presence, listening, empathy, self-compassion, honest boundaries, and de-escalation, practiced deliberately until they hold up under stress.

roadmaps.title: Speaking & Communication
roadmaps.tagline: From listening well to holding a room: the speaking skills nobody formally teaches you
roadmaps.endpoint: from nervous small talk to holding a room with confidence
roadmaps.about: Communication is the skill of being understood and of understanding — in conversation, in conflict, and in front of a room. This category walks from listening well, through asking better questions and speaking clearly, to the harder terrain of difficult conversations, persuasion, and public speaking.

roadmaps.title: Everyday Critical Thinking
roadmaps.tagline: Spot weak claims, tame your biases, and reason clearly about a noisy world.
roadmaps.curricula: Informal-logic courses, UW's Calling Bullshit curriculum, and Tetlock's Good Judgment forecasting research
roadmaps.endpoint: from gut takes to calmly dismantling a weak claim
roadmaps.about: Critical thinking is the discipline of believing things for good reasons — spotting weak claims, checking sources, and noticing when your own mind is the one fooling you. This category covers the practical toolkit: how arguments work, the biases everyone carries, how statistics mislead, and the habits that keep reasoning honest in a noisy information environment.

roadmaps.title: Financial Literacy Basics
roadmaps.tagline: Understand how money actually works — compounding, credit, taxes, and risk — without the sales pitch.
roadmaps.curricula: CFPB financial well-being framework and Jump$tart Coalition national standards
roadmaps.disclaimer: Strictly conceptual education — never financial, investment, or tax advice, and no product recommendations. For guidance, see consumerfinance.gov and investor.gov.
roadmaps.endpoint: from paycheck confusion to understanding compounding, credit, and risk
roadmaps.about: Personal finance is the working knowledge of how money behaves — earning, spending, saving, borrowing, and the quiet arithmetic of compounding that rewards or punishes over decades. This category teaches the concepts: budgets, credit, interest, taxes, insurance, and risk, so that financial decisions are made with understanding rather than hope.

roadmaps.title: Learning Any Language
roadmaps.tagline: From zero to real conversations, using the science of how adults actually acquire languages
roadmaps.curricula: CEFR framework, FSI language-learning research, Krashen's comprehensible-input theory
roadmaps.endpoint: from zero to real conversations in your target language
roadmaps.about: Learning a language as an adult is a learnable process of its own, with methods that work far better than schoolroom memorization — massive comprehensible input, spaced repetition, and early, imperfect conversation. This category teaches that process for any target language: how acquisition actually happens, how to build vocabulary that sticks, and how to reach real conversations from zero.

roadmaps.title: Writing Well
roadmaps.tagline: Clear thinking made visible — from clean sentences to work you actually ship
roadmaps.curricula: University composition curricula, Zinsser's On Writing Well, Strunk & White's The Elements of Style
roadmaps.endpoint: from clean sentences to work you actually ship
roadmaps.about: Writing is clear thinking made visible — the craft of putting ideas into sentences a reader can follow without effort. This category works from the sentence up: clarity, structure, revision, and voice, toward the discipline that separates writers from people with ideas — actually finishing and shipping work.

roadmaps.title: Drawing Foundations
roadmaps.tagline: Train your eye and hand from first marks to a durable daily practice.
roadmaps.curricula: Classical atelier training, Drawabox, and Betty Edwards' Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain
roadmaps.endpoint: from first marks to a durable daily drawing practice
roadmaps.about: Drawing is a trainable coordination of eye and hand — learning to see what is actually there and to put it on paper with intent. This category walks the classical fundamentals in order: contour and line, construction from basic forms, value and light, perspective, gesture, and composition, sustained by the daily practice that makes each of them stick.

roadmaps.title: Music Fundamentals
roadmaps.tagline: Learn how music actually works — rhythm, melody, harmony, and a trained ear.
roadmaps.curricula: ABRSM Music Theory Grades 1–3 and aural-skills syllabi
roadmaps.endpoint: from clapping rhythms to hearing how harmony works
roadmaps.about: Music theory and ear training are the grammar of music — how rhythm, melody, and harmony work, and how to hear them working. This category builds musicianship any instrument can use: reading rhythm, singing intervals, understanding scales and chords, and training the ear until written music and heard music become the same language.

roadmaps.title: Photography Essentials
roadmaps.tagline: See light, master exposure, and make deliberate photographs — phone camera included.
roadmaps.endpoint: from auto mode to deliberate photographs in manual
roadmaps.about: Photography is deliberate seeing — understanding light, controlling exposure, and composing a frame on purpose, with any camera including the one in your pocket. This category walks from how a camera actually works through aperture, shutter, and ISO, to composition, natural light, and developing a personal eye.
